snippet.title: Recharge - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
This stunning RC-style multiplayer racer with Unreal-powered, near-photoreal, visuals shared a new trailer in the FGS LIve From gamescom latam showcase. The new footage revealed three brand-new maps for Recharge, a new RC car racing game from Room Games. Coming to Early Access in Summer 2025. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #gamescomlatam 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
